title: (RHEA-2025:10414) Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.1.0 release on RHEL 10
portal_summary: Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.1 is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 10.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.1.0 release on RHEL 10
portal_product_filter: JBoss Enterprise Web Server|JBoss Enterprise Web Server|6|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat JBoss Web Server is a fully integrated and certified set of components for hosting Java web applications. It is comprised of the Apache Tomcat Servlet container, JBoss HTTP Connector (mod_cluster), the PicketLink Vault extension for Apache Tomcat, and the Tomcat Native library.

This release of Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.1.0 is the first release of Red Hat JBoss Web Server on RHEL 10. This release includes bug fixes, enhancements and component upgrades, which are documented in the Release Notes that are linked to in the References section.
